notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
Hello there!

First of all we want to thank you for your attention! We have good news, brand new update is here. This version contains not only balance change, bug fixes and other cosmetic changes, but also new features. It was a great experience to talk to you and get your reactions. We think new update can make gaming experience on red planet MEGALAN 11 more interesting! Here is the list of changes:


 graphic enhancing
 more sounds
 fauna aggression balance change 
 repair parts balance change 
 you can exit to menu 
 drone companion is added
 and other slight tweaks


Thank you for being with us, have a great day!

notes.title: First day patch vol. 4
notes.notes:
More changes, please have a look. New patch is ready for download!

List of changes:

 repair parts don't stuck in walls
 full bag sound work all the time
 dead-zone of gamepad sticks is bigger now
 items on the fifth floor don't disappear now
 and more tweaks and small fixes


Thank you for support, please enjoy!

notes.title: First day patch vol. 3
notes.notes:
More changes, please have a look. New patch is ready for download!

List of changes:

 treasure chest is now working correctly
 no clipping through walls now
 defense platform is now working correctly (you can't put two elements at once)
 no flying near the blue structure
 communication screen can't be used through wall
 lantern head is now lights inside a blue structure
 all lifts are now working more consistent
 and more tweaks and small fixes


Thank you for support, please enjoy!

notes.title: First day patch vol. 2
notes.notes:
For these couple of days we were working on updates. You can look through fresh list of latest fixes. New patch is ready for download!

List of changes:

 tuned sound volume of some effects
 background music doesn't overlay other music now
 correct rank number in the end
 repairing speed is increased
 better physics of repair parts
 added description of kitchen
 glitch with zero metal for repair destroyed defense element
 no auto-save warning
 added description of kitchen
 glitch with zero metal for repair destroyed defense element
 added ui hints for hitting and navigation use
 new graphic for saving
 and more tweaks and small fixes


Thank you for support, please enjoy!

notes.title: We've finished quick patch
notes.notes:
We've received first feedback and want to present new update. You can download new version right now

List of changes:

 pick up animations is more stable
 UI adaptation is more flexible 
 appearance of higher floors in the wrong time is fixed
 hard difficulty is now available only after first walk through on normal
 and more tweaks and small fixes


Thank you for support, please enjoy!
